summary: Pinterest requires a mandatory manual review process for all applications before they can access the API. Developers must verify their email, accept terms, and submit their app for approval, which makes the setup process time-consuming and dependent on external review.

approval.notes: All application requests are reviewed by Pinterest, and developers receive an email notification regarding approval or denial.

steps.title: Verify Account
steps.detail: Verify your account's email address and accept the Developer Terms of Service in the My apps section.

steps.title: Register App
steps.detail: Submit app details for registration to receive an app ID and secret key.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URI
steps.detail: Navigate to the Configure tab in your app profile, enter your redirect URI, and save the changes.

steps.title: Submit for Review
steps.detail: Submit the application for review by Pinterest to gain access.

nuances: There is a 'Trial access' tier mentioned, but full access requires a formal review process.
Product limited tokens can be generated after Trial access approval to test the API without a full OAuth flow.
agent_can_do: Draft the application name and description.
Identify required scopes based on documentation.
Store the app ID and secret key in secure environment variables.
Configure the redirect URI in the developer console.
human_must_do: Accept the Developer Terms of Service.
Submit the application for manual review.
